headline: A new law authorizes Congressional Gold Medals for the members of the 1980 U.S. Olympic men's ice hockey team.
what_it_does: The act provides for the award of Congressional Gold Medals to the members of the 1980 U.S. Olympic men's ice hockey team. The medals recognize the team's achievement at the 1980 Winter Olympic Games. The official summary does not describe medal design, ceremony details, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The act became law on December 12, 2025. The summary does not give a separate date for the medal award.
